metadata.description: AI image, video and song generation for Claude, via the Abracadabrax MCP servers.

plugins.name: abracadabrax-image-video
plugins.description: Create AI images and videos from a text prompt: review model, aspect ratio and duration in a panel, then generate them in your Abracadabrax account.

plugins.name: abracadabrax-song-maker
plugins.description: Turn an idea into a finished song: write the lyrics with Claude, set style, vocals and length in a panel, then render the track in your Abracadabrax account.
